candidate.title: MNQ VWAP pullback continuation (5m)
candidate.one_line: On MNQ 5m, require a short same-side-of-VWAP trend, pullback to VWAP within an ATR band, then enter on the first close back through VWAP in the trend direction; ATR stop, 2R target, max 2 trades, flat 15:55. Source: Tarrow Futures VWAP pullback rule card (adapted 1m→5m).

sources.title: VWAP Pullback Strategy: Rules on Real MNQ Charts
sources.creator: Tarrow Futures
sources.claim: Trend: last N closes on one side of session VWAP; pullback to the 1σ/ATR band; enter on first close back in trend direction; stop at pullback extreme; target 2R; window 10:00-14:30; max 2 trades/day.

hypothesis.behavior: On MNQ trend days, institutional VWAP participation creates pullbacks to session VWAP that resume the morning trend once price reclaims the line.
failure_theory: Source is a teaching rule card with selected example days, not a published multi-year backtest.
5m adaptation of a 1m rule card changes timing and may miss or invent signals.
Range days produce repeated VWAP crosses that stop out under a 2-trade cap.

setup: MNQ RTH 09:30-16:00 ET on 5m bars; session VWAP from the cash open; signals on completed bars, fill next open.
long_entry: 10:00-14:30: SMA(close,trend_bars) above VWAP; low tags within band_atr*ATR of VWAP; bullish close still above VWAP.
short_entry: Mirror: SMA below VWAP; high tags VWAP band; bearish close still below VWAP.

exits.time_exit: Flat by 15:55 ET; no overnight position.

trend_bars.rationale: 5m bars for same-side-of-VWAP trend (~15/20/30 minutes); source uses 20 one-minute closes.

band_atr.rationale: How close the pullback low/high must get to VWAP, in ATR(14) multiples (proxy for source 1σ band).

stop_atr.rationale: Stop distance in ATR(14); source uses pullback extreme — ATR is the expressible proxy.

candidate_specific_checks: Evaluate only the predeclared grid; no expansion after seeing results.

exclusions: No paper/live trading or automatic promotion.
Honest 5m adaptation of a 1m rule card; SMA same-side proxy replaces 'last N closes all on one side'; ATR band proxies 1σ; stop is ATR not pullback extreme.

prior_work.closest_tried: 2026-10-22-qqq-vwap-trend (rejected VWAP side-hold); QF also has SPY VWAP mean-reversion and VWAP trendfollow break±ATR
prior_work.claimed_difference: MNQ futures, pullback-to-VWAP then resume (not side-hold, not fade stretch); requires same-side trend filter before the reclaim cross.
